# Modern Coverage

> **Headline (manual, 2026-05-28):** Raw 27.5% (6022 / 21917) ·
> Live mtgtop8 Modern top-20 most-played: 20 / 20. Sampled played-pool staple
> coverage ~51% (see Headline numbers note). Refresh the on-disk factory / template
> counts in the table below with `./scripts/update-coverage-headline.sh`
> (CI hook: `--check` exits non-zero on drift).
>
> The card pool itself ships embedded in `Majik.Core` as
> `CardData/Embedded/modern-cards.json.gz`. **Card factory PRs do NOT
> regenerate this file** — `IsImplemented` is derived at load time from
> the `[CardName]` registry (`Majik.Core/CardData/Factories/ImplementedCardNames.cs`),
> so adding a factory flips the flag automatically. Only regenerate the
> seed on a Scryfall data refresh (new cards / errata) via
> `dotnet run --project Majik.Console -- export-modern-cards <scryfall.json>`.

When a `ReplacementBus` is supplied, `Pay` routes through `CountersService.Add` so Vizier of Remedies / Hardened Scales / Doubling Season can rewrite or cancel the cost payload; null bus falls through to a direct `Permanent.Counters.Add`. `DevotedDruidFactory` (Shadowmoor Creature — Elf Druid {1}{G} 0/2) ships the printed `ManaAbility({T}: Add {G})` (CR 605.1 — implicit self-tap; no priority pass) plus the untap activated ability — costs `[AddCounterCost(card, CounterType.MinusOneMinusOne, 1, replacements)]`, single `Effect("untap self", () => card.Untap())`. Two-overload shape: `Create(Player)` is shape-only (no bus → counter lands directly on each activation), `Create(Player, ReplacementBus?)` is the combo path. `VizierOfRemediesFactory` (Amonkhet Creature — Human Cleric {W}{W} 2/1) ships the static replacement via the new `VizierOfRemediesReplacement : IReplacementEffect&lt;CounterAddIntent&gt;` — `Applies` gates on (a) `_source.Zone == Battlefield` (CR 614.6 — replacement only active on the battlefield, same lifecycle-via-Applies posture as `HardenedScalesAddReplacement` and `SoulScarMageDamageReplacement` — flicker / LTB lifts the rider naturally without explicit unregister), (b) `intent.Type == MinusOneMinusOne`, (c) `intent.Amount >= 1`, (d) `intent.Target is Creature`, (e) `target.Controller == _source.Controller`. `Replace` rewrites `intent with { Amount = 0 }` so `CountersService.Add` commits no counters and returns 0 (the printed "instead put no counter" payload — equivalent to a full cancel since the engine treats Amount=0 as a no-op commit). With Devoted Druid + Vizier on the battlefield + a wired `ReplacementBus`, the loop is arbitrarily long — infinite green mana, the classic Druid Combo. **Last updated:** 2026-05-25 (Deceiver Exarch + Pestermite + Splinter Twin audit — UR Twin combo pair. Two new factories under `Majik.Core/CardData/Factories/` completing the iconic Modern Splinter Twin shell. `DeceiverExarchFactory` (New Phyrexia Creature — Cleric {2}{U} 1/4) ships the 1/4 Cleric shape + `KeywordAbility("Flash")` marker (CR 702.8) + an ETB `TriggeredAbility` (CR 603.6a) via `Triggers.OnEnterBattlefieldSelf` with a single mandatory 1..1 "target permanent" `TargetRequest`. CR 700.2d printed modal "Choose one — • Untap target permanent an opponent controls. • Untap target noncreature permanent you control." is collapsed in v1 into a fused-predicate union request because both modes share the same effect ("Untap target ~"); the resolve closure re-checks the union legality at resolution (CR 608.2b — target must be on the battlefield AND either controlled by an opponent OR a non-creature controlled by the ability's controller), then untaps if currently tapped (CR 701.27 idempotent on an already-untapped permanent — defensive guard since `Permanent.Untap` throws on already-untapped state). Own-creature target → ability does nothing (neither mode legal). True modal "Choose one —" prompt with `IPlayerAgent.ChooseModeAsync` deferred — current ETB-modal infra exists only for spell casts (Izzet Charm / Archmage's Charm / Cryptic Command), not triggered abilities. `PestermiteFactory` (Lorwyn Creature — Faerie Rogue {2}{U} 2/1) ships the 2/1 Faerie Rogue shape + `KeywordAbility("Flash")` + `KeywordAbility("Flying")` markers (CR 702.8 / 702.9 — Flying read by `CombatAbilities.HasFlying` for combat legality; Flash gates instant-speed casting) + an ETB `TriggeredAbility` (CR 603.6a) with a 0..1 "target permanent" `TargetRequest` (printed "you may" modelled by `MinTargets=0` so the controller may decline the trigger — same posture as Solitude's free-decline). Resolution uses the deterministic "useful flip" v1 collapse over the printed binary "tap or untap" mode — untap if currently tapped, tap if currently untapped, so the Twin chain always advances when paired with Splinter Twin. Resolve-time legality check: target must still be on the battlefield (CR 608.2b — illegal-at-resolution → clean no-op). Agent-driven "may" decline / explicit tap-vs-untap mode prompt deferred — shared queue with the broader modal-trigger surface. **Splinter Twin audit**: PR #468's `SplinterTwinFactory` token-copy ability projection (CR 706.2) verified end-to-end via the existing `Majik.Core.Tests/Effects/SplinterTwinTokenChainTests.cs` (4 tests) — token inherits the granted "{T}: create token copy" activated ability with `Source == token` per CR 602.1b; activating the token's inherited ability spawns a second token that itself perpetuates the chain (Name + Haste keyword + inherited ActivatedAbility, name copied from bearer via copy-of-a-copy CR 706.2); every spawned token's delayed end-step exile fires independently on `StepStartedEvent(End)` (CR 603.7); aura LTB revokes the bearer's grant but NOT the tokens' inherited grant (CR 706.2 — copiable values fixed at copy time, divorced from the aura's `AttachedAuraAbilityGrantStaticEffect` lifecycle binder). Audit confirms no gaps in the Twin chain machinery — the two new partners drop into the combo with no factory-side changes needed. The historical "Pestermite-like" stand-in vanilla creature fixture in the chain tests becomes redundant once the production Pestermite ships but is left in place as a minimal unit-test isolation harness. Bedlam Reveler is the missing piece in this five-card pillar — the graveyard-density payoff that closes out games after Lightning Bolt / Faithless Looting / Thoughtseize / Young Pyromancer / Liliana of the Veil fuel the yard. Mill-trigger resolution: `IPlayerAgent.ChooseYesNoAsync(BotIntent.LoseLife | BotIntent.Heal)` to "exile it" (auto-accept on null agent), `ZoneService.MoveCard` Graveyard → Exile, then re-runs the burn-and-life-gain body via shared `ApplyBurnAndLifeGain(controller, opponentResolver)` helper (CR 117.2 — equivalent text means equivalent effect). **Last updated:** 2026-05-25 (Dredge primitive (CR 702.52) + Life from the Loam + Stinkweed Imp + Golgari Grave-Troll. New `Majik.Core/Keywords/DredgeFactory.cs` — shared graveyard-anchored draw replacement builder. `Build(source, n, replacementBus?, eventBus?)` attaches a `KeywordAbility "Dredge"` marker carrying `Arg = N` and registers a `LambdaReplacement<DrawCardIntent>` on the supplied `ReplacementBus`. The replacement gates on (a) would-draw player matches `source.Owner` (CR 702.52 — "you" = source controller; uses owner since the card is in a graveyard / no separate controller), (b) `source.Zone == Graveyard` (CR 702.52a — Dredge functions only from the graveyard), (c) `owner.Library.Count >= N` (CR 702.52b — can't dredge with fewer cards than N), (d) agent yes via `IPlayerAgent.ChooseYesNoAsync` with `BotIntent.CardAdvantage` (the default heuristic accepts). On yes: mill N via `MillAction.Apply` (CR 701.13 — clean halt on mid-mill empty library; CR 704.5b empty-library loss flag NOT set because milling an empty library is not a draw from empty), return source Graveyard → Hand, cancel the underlying draw (return null). On no: pass intent through, underlying draw resolves. No-agent default = pass-through (conservative posture). The source-anchored gate means zone changes (return to hand, exile, reanimate, shuffle into library) silently disable the replacement without unregistering — re-entering the graveyard re-enables it (CR 614.6). New `Effects/DrawCardIntent.cs` — sealed record `DrawCardIntent(Player Player)` routed through `Fx.DrawCards` per individual draw when `player.Replacements` is non-null (per-draw routing so a "draw 3" with a single Dredge offer dredges once, draws twice). `LifeFromTheLoamFactory` (Ravnica Sorcery {1}{G}): Sorcery shape + Dredge 3 marker + `BuildResolveEffect(caster, landSelector?, zoneService?)` exposing the "return up to three target land cards from your graveyard to your hand" body (deterministic first-three-lands fallback, CR 608.2b illegal-on-resolution recheck filters non-lands + library-absent picks, ZoneService-routed when supplied). `StinkweedImpFactory` (Ravnica Creature — Imp {1}{B} 1/2): Flying marker + combat-damage-to-a-creature trigger (CR 510 / CR 603.1) over `CombatDamageDealtEvent` filtered to `e.Source == card && e.Target is Creature` (player + planeswalker targets gated out) destroying the victim via `Fx.MoveToGraveyard(victim, ZoneMoveReason.Destroy)` (Indestructible + Regeneration shields apply, CR 608.2b illegal-on-resolution clean no-op) + Dredge 5 marker. `GolgariGraveTrollFactory` (Ravnica Creature — Zombie Troll {3}{B}{G} base 0/0): ETB trigger (CR 603.6a / CR 614.1d retrofit) over `CardMovedEvent` `FromZone != Battlefield && ToZone == Battlefield` for this card, resolution counts Creature cards in controller's graveyard at resolve time and adds that many `CounterType.PlusOnePlusOne` counters via direct `Permanent.Counters.Add` (same shape as Murktide Regent's delve-counter retrofit; empty-graveyard branch dies to SBA after trigger per CR 704.5f) + Dredge 6 marker. Introduces `CardSubtype.Troll`. New `Fx.DrawCards` wiring: each individual draw constructs a `DrawCardIntent` and routes through `player.Replacements.Apply` when attached; null result skips the library → hand move for THIS draw only (the remaining draws in a "draw N" loop continue). New tests: `Majik.Core.Tests/Keywords/DredgeFactoryTests.cs` (10 — keyword + arg marker, argument validation (null source / non-positive N / owner-not-wired), shape-only no-bus path, agent yes mills N + source → hand + cancels draw, agent no straight draw + source stays in graveyard, library < N gates offer (agent NOT prompted), source not in graveyard skips, mid-mill empty library halts cleanly without empty-library loss flag, no-agent default = straight draw) + `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/StinkweedImpTests.cs` (7 — identity (Imp 1/2 at {1}{B}), dispatch, Flying marker, Dredge 5 marker, combat trigger shape, combat-damage-to-creature destroys victim end-to-end, combat-damage-to-player does NOT fire) + `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/GolgariGraveTrollTests.cs` (6 — identity (Zombie Troll 0/0 at {3}{B}{G}), dispatch, Dredge 6 marker, ETB trigger shape, ETB-counters one-per-Creature-card (3 creatures + 1 sorcery → 3 counters), empty-graveyard ETB places 0 counters) + `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/LifeFromTheLoamTests.cs` (6 — identity (Sorcery at {1}{G}), dispatch, Dredge 3 marker, default selector picks first three lands + filters non-lands, empty-graveyard clean no-op, custom selector picks supplied lands). All 6408 Core + 304 Server + 149 Api + 135 Bot + 3 Bot.Integration tests pass. Coverage NamedFactory tier +3 (Life from the Loam / Stinkweed Imp / Golgari Grave-Troll). Cards-db is being removed — pure factory + Effects work, no JSON / SQL paths touched. CR 702.52 primitive unblocks every printed Dredge card (Stinkweed Imp / Golgari Grave-Troll / Life from the Loam ship today; future Dredge cards — Grave-Shell Scarab, Putrid Imp, Sprouting Thrinax wing, Greater Mossdog, Darkblast, Smolder Initiate, etc. — slot in via a single `DredgeFactory.Build(card, N, bus)` line).)

**Last updated (prior):** 2026-05-25 (`DamageIntent.IsCombatDamage` flag + Inquisitor's Flail damage-doubling retrofit. Engine change: `Majik.Core/Effects/DamageIntent.cs` grows a `bool IsCombatDamage { get; init; }` init-prop (default `false`) discriminating combat damage (CR 510.1) from every other damage-dealing path (spell resolution, activated / triggered abilities, ping effects). `Majik.Core/Combat/CombatFlow.cs` stamps `IsCombatDamage = true` on every intent it pumps through `ReplacementBus` — all three `DealDamageTo{Creature,Player,Planeswalker}` routes — so combat-damage-only replacements can gate cleanly without guessing from source / target shape. Non-combat construction sites (`DamageSpellFactory`, Soul-Scar Mage's existing rider, the `PreventNextN*` shield family) leave the flag at its default `false`. `InquisitorsFlailFactory` retrofit: PR #543 shipped Equip {2} + structural shape only with the damage-doubling clauses deferred. This PR closes the gap — `Create(Player, ReplacementBus?)` overload registers two new `DamageDoubleReplacement` instances against the supplied bus: (1) source-side ("if equipped creature would deal combat damage, it deals double that damage instead" — gates on `intent.Source == AttachedTo` AND `IsCombatDamage`) and (2) target-side ("if a source would deal combat damage to equipped creature, it deals double that damage instead" — gates on `intent.TargetCreature == AttachedTo` AND `IsCombatDamage`). Both replacements gate on the Flail being on the battlefield AND currently attached, so detach / blink / bounce auto-suspends doubling without explicit deregistration. The single-arg `Create(Player)` dispatcher path stays shape-only (no bus → no replacements). New `DamageDoubleReplacement` (alongside the factory in `Majik.Core/CardData/Factories/InquisitorsFlailFactory.cs`) is the generic "double a combat-damage intent matching a per-side predicate" replacement primitive; future retrofits (Furnace of Rath, Gisela the Broken Blade, Boros Charm's third mode) can lean on the same shape with their own gates. **Last updated:** 2026-05-25 (Tutor / fetch routing through `ZoneService` — engine-wide ETB-trigger / replacement-effect fix. Closes the gap flagged in the prior Sakura-Tribe Scout + Explore + Amulet Titan engine audit: tutor-then-place-onto-battlefield factories (`PrimevalTitanFactory`, `ScapeshiftFactory`, `FetchLandCycleFactory`, `SearchSpellFactory.SearchLandToBattlefieldSpell` / `GreenSunsZenithSpell` — covering `SearchForTomorrowFactory`, every `[CardName]` fetchland, and any `SearchLandToBattlefield*Template`-bound spell) previously did raw `Zones.Library.RemoveCard` + `Zones.Battlefield.AddCard` mutation, bypassing `ZoneService.MoveCard`'s `CardMovedEvent` publication + `ReplacementBus` hook. Consequences pre-fix: bounce-land ETB self-bounce did NOT fire on Titan / Scapeshift / Fetchland-tutored Karoos; Amulet of Vigor's "Whenever a permanent enters tapped under your control, untap it" trigger did NOT fire on Titan-fetched tapped lands; ETB-tapped replacement effects on shock lands / bounce lands never applied to tutored arrivals — the printed Amulet Titan combo line only worked through cast-side land drops, never through the Titan's own fetch. Fix: new `Majik.Core/Services/ZoneServiceRegistry.cs` (parallel to `AgentRegistry` / `GameRandomRegistry` / `EventBusRegistry` — process-wide per-player lookup populated by `GameDriver` at game-start, cleared at test teardown) lets the tutor closure (built at card-construction time, executed at spell resolution) look up the live `ZoneService` without forcing a parameter-threading rewrite through `SpellDefinition.EffectFactory`. Retrofitted factories now consult `ZoneServiceRegistry.Get(caster)` — when a live service is registered the Library → Battlefield move routes through `ZoneService.MoveCard` so `CardMovedEvent` publishes + the `ReplacementBus` runs (CR 603.6a / CR 614). When nothing is registered (single-arg dispatcher / shape-test path) the closure falls back to raw zone mutation, so existing shape tests continue to pass unchanged. `PrimevalTitanFactory.MoveToBattlefieldTapped` taps the land AFTER the `ZoneService` move so the bounce-land / shock-land ETB-tapped replacement has already applied — double-tapping is a no-op (`Permanent.Tap` throws if already tapped; the new code guards `!perm.IsTapped` before tapping). Amulet of Vigor's untap trigger queues off the same `CardMovedEvent` because `ZoneService.MoveCard` calls `Permanent.Tap` BEFORE publishing the event, so the trigger's `IsTapped` predicate evaluates true at event-fire time (CR 614.6 — replacements fully resolve before triggers see the event). `ChordOfCallingFactory` / `GreenSunsZenithFactory` / `EldritchEvolutionFactory` / `UroTitanFactory` already had optional `ZoneService?` params on their `BuildSpellDefinition` entry points; updated to fall back to `ZoneServiceRegistry.Get(caster)` when the caller-supplied service is null — closes the cast-flow path where bots / `OracleSpellBinder` invoke `BuildSpellDefinition` without an explicit service ref. `GameDriver` deliberately does NOT call `ZoneServiceRegistry.SetDefault` (only per-player `Set(p, _zoneService)`) — keeps unrelated tests (which create a fresh `Player` and don't seed the registry) from inadvertently inheriting a stale `ZoneService` from a concurrently-running test collection. Tests: new `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/Factories/PrimevalTitanZoneServiceTests.cs` (4 tests — Primeval Titan tutors Simic Growth Chamber via `ZoneService` → bounce trigger queues on the live `TriggerManager`; Amulet of Vigor + Primeval Titan tutors Simic Growth Chamber → bounce-land ETB-tapped replacement applies + post-move tap is no-op + Amulet's untap trigger queues alongside the bounce trigger (CR 614 / CR 603.6a); direct `CardMovedEvent` observation verifies the tutor publishes one event with `FromZone=Library` + `ToZone=Battlefield`; no-registered-service fallback path produces the same end state via raw zone mutation so existing dispatcher / shape tests stay green). All 5748 Core + 304 Server + 149 Api + 135 Bot + 3 Bot.Integration tests pass. Coverage NamedFactory tier unchanged (engine retrofit, not new factories). Cards-db is being removed — pure engine work, no JSON / SQL paths touched. Unblocks Amulet Titan combo lines: Titan ETB → fetches Simic Growth Chamber tapped → Karoo's ETB self-bounce returns the originally-played land → Amulet of Vigor untaps Simic Growth Chamber → tapped-Karoo state cleared → bot evaluator sees the bounce-and-untap tempo correctly. Same fix sequence covers Scapeshift's "sacrifice N lands → fetch N lands" Karoo abuse and Search for Tomorrow's suspend / hardcast paths.)

Multi-Explore stacking is additive (each cast reads the post-prior cap). The two halves of the spell are independent — null tracker shape-path skips the bump but the draw still runs. **Amulet Titan engine audit findings**: (a) `AmuletOfVigorFactory`'s `CardMovedEvent` subscriber correctly fires on bounce lands fetched via `Sakura-Tribe Scout` / cast-from-hand because `ZoneService.MoveCard` applies the `ConditionalEntersTappedReplacement` (predicate always-false) before publishing the event, so `Permanent.IsTapped == true` when Amulet's trigger condition evaluates (CR 614.6 — replacements fully resolve before triggered abilities see the event). (b) **Known gap (not fixed here)**: `PrimevalTitanFactory.MoveToBattlefieldTapped` does manual `caster.Zones.Battlefield.AddCard(pick)` + `perm.Tap()` instead of routing through `ZoneService.MoveCard`. Consequences: (i) `CardMovedEvent` is NOT published, so Amulet of Vigor's tapped-ETB trigger does NOT fire on lands fetched by Primeval Titan — the printed Amulet Titan combo line "Titan ETBs → fetches Karoo, Amulet untaps Karoo" only works through the cast-side land-drop, not the Titan's own fetch; (ii) bounce land ETB self-bounce triggers also do NOT fire on Titan-fetched bounce lands. The end-state tapped flag is correct (Titan manually taps), so the bot's static evaluation isn't broken — but the dynamic combo lines that read `CardMovedEvent` won't surface. This is the established v1 pattern (Scapeshift / Search for Tomorrow share the same raw-zone-fetch shape) and migrating to `ZoneService`-routed fetches is documented as a separate engine-wide pass — flagged here so the next Amulet Titan polish PR can address the cycle holistically rather than piecemeal. New tests: `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/SakuraTribeScoutTests.cs` (7 tests — identity (1/1 Snake Scout), `NamedCardFactory` dispatch, activated-ability cost shape (one ICost + one effect), land-in-hand moves to battlefield, no-land clean no-op, mixed hand picks first land, `ZoneService`-routed move publishes `CardMovedEvent`) + `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/ExploreTests.cs` (7 tests — identity ({1}{G} Sorcery), `NamedCardFactory` dispatch, bumps max 1→2 + draws one, null tracker skips bump + still draws, two Explores stack additively (1→2→3), `ResetTurn` drops the bump, empty library stamps loss flag + bump still applies). Snapshot drift fix: `Majik.Core.Tests/Snapshots/snapshots/ohran-frostfang.json` updated to include `"Snake"` in subtypes now that the enum exists. All 5746 Core + 304 Server + 149 Api + 135 Bot + 3 Bot.Integration tests green. Coverage NamedFactory tier 370 → 372. Cards-db is being removed — pure factory work, no JSON / SQL paths touched. Amulet Titan engine unlock: Sakura-Tribe Scout completes the cast-side ramp loop (turn-1 Forest + Scout, turn-2 Amulet, turn-3 Karoo + Scout untaps it for {G}{G} + bounce + drop again); Explore is the cantrip ramp insurance pillar.)

**Latest origin/main:** Layer-4 type-strip primitive + Heliod devotion gate. New `Majik.Core/Effects/Layer4TypeStripEffect.cs` is a CR 205.2 / 613.1d Layer 4 (type-changing) continuous effect that conditionally strips `CardType.Creature` from a permanent while a controller-supplied `Func<bool>` predicate evaluates true. Source-anchored — `IsActive` gates on the source being on the battlefield, so the effect self-terminates on LTB; predicate is re-evaluated on every `ContinuousEffectsService.Compute` pass so live conditions (devotion, life totals, colour counts) drive the gate without re-registering. Layer-4-only — does NOT touch P/T / abilities / subtypes; stacks alongside other Layer 4 effects via timestamp + dependency sort (latest-timestamp wins per CR 613.7 when paired with a Layer 4 ADD-Creature effect like `KarnAnimateArtifactEffect` / `MutavaultFactory`'s animate). `HeliodSunCrownedFactory` gains a `(owner, triggers, effects)` overload that stamps the supplied `ContinuousEffectsService` onto `Card.ActiveEffects` and registers `Layer4TypeStripEffect(card, () => ComputeDevotionToWhite(controller) < 5)` (clears PR #506's deferred type-strip — Heliod now correctly becomes a non-creature while devotion < 5 and recovers Creature when devotion hits 5+ via cast/LTB without effect re-registration). Tests: `Layer4TypeStripTests` covers strip-while-true / lifts-when-false / live-predicate / scope-to-source / source-LTB termination / stacks-with-other-Layer-4 (AddSubtype additive, KarnAnimate timestamp-wins) / null-arg guards. `HeliodSunCrownedTests` gains four scenarios: devotion-4 strips Creature, ineligible as a Doom-Blade target (creature-only predicate fails), devotion bumps to 5 restores Creature, devotion drops below 5 strips again. On top of Storm-pillar audit + Past in Flames (Sorcery {3}{R}, Innistrad). Audit confirms `Majik.Core/Keywords/StormHelper.cs` is the single shared on-cast trigger helper used by `BrainFreezeFactory` + `TendrilsOfAgonyFactory` (Storm-keyword cards); both use it identically (capture-into-closure storm-count read at trigger-evaluation time from `TurnState.SpellsCastByPlayer - 1`, then N `SpellCopier.PushCopyOfTopSpell` invocations on resolution). CR 702.40a "you may choose new targets" + copies-as-distinct-stack-objects gaps remain as documented (inherited from `SpellCopier`). `Manamorphose` already shipped with `ManamorphoseFactory` (Instant {1}{R/G}, "Add two mana in any combination of colors. Draw a card.") — audit confirmed no new `IPlayerAgent.ChooseManaColorsAsync` hook exists; existing caller-supplied `Func<Player, ManaColor[]>` colour-picker + deterministic `{R}{G}` default is the correct posture. New `PastInFlamesFactory.Create` ships the sorcery shape; `BuildResolveEffect(controller, eventBus)` walks `controller.Zones.Graveyard.GetCards()`, filters via `HasType(CardType.Instant) || HasType(CardType.Sorcery)`, skips Past in Flames itself by name (its printed Flashback {4}{R} is the authoritative cost, not {3}{R}), and stamps `Card.GrantRuntimeFlashback` with each card's own `ManaCostValue` per CR 702.34. EOT cleanup via one-shot `StepStartedEvent`→`Cleanup` subscription clears every grant from the same resolution (CR 514.2 — same shape as `FlashbackFactory` + `SnapcasterMageFactory`). Printed Flashback {4}{R} on Past in Flames itself wired via `GetFlashbackAlternativeCost()` producing `FlashbackAlternativeCost(ManaCost.Parse("{4}{R}"))`. Bot-side discovery free via existing `RuntimeFlashbackAltCostProbe`. `Majik.Core.Tests/CardData/Factories/PastInFlamesFactoryTests.cs` covers identity + dispatcher + grant-each-instant-sorcery + skips-creatures + skips-opponent-graveyard + skips-self + empty-graveyard no-op + EOT cleanup via bus + printed Flashback {4}{R} alt-cost. On top of Sorcery-speed activation gate (CR 117.1a / 307.5 — infrastructure PR). `ActivatedAbility` grows a `bool sorcerySpeed` ctor parameter + `IsSorcerySpeed` getter on `IActivatedAbility`; `ActivateAbilityAction` mirrors the cast-side `CastSpellAction.SorcerySpeedAvailable` pattern with a `(ability, player, sorcerySpeedAvailable)` overload (single-arg ctor defaults `SorcerySpeedAvailable: true` so the engine's hundreds of legacy activate-call sites are unaffected). `ActionValidator.ValidateActivateAbility` rejects sorcery-speed-only activations when the caller signals the window is closed, returning `RuleViolation("307.5", "activate-only-as-a-sorcery")`. `CardDefinitionFactory.BuildActivatedAbility` threads the JSON `sorcerySpeed` flag onto the runtime ability so JSON-defined cards (Walking Ballista's {4}: put counter) light up automatically. X provenance: callers pass the resolved X directly (same simplification as Pernicious Deed / Engineered Explosives). Bumps Burn rollup to ~87% and Murktide / Izzet Tempo rollup to ~78%) on top of Geralf's Messenger (Creature — Zombie {B}{B}{B} 3/2 from Dark Ascension — Modern Mono-Black Aggro / Zombies finisher and a Yawgmoth-pillar Undying body. `GeralfsMessengerFactory.Create` ships the 3/2 Zombie shape, Undying `KeywordAbility` marker (CR 702.93) wired alongside the return-with-+1/+1-counter mechanic via the shared `UndyingFactory.Build` helper (same wiring Young Wolf / Strangleroot Geist would use). Enters-tapped replacement (CR 614.1c) via `EntersTappedReplacement` on the supplied `ReplacementBus` — unconditional, no gate (contrast Valakut's 5-Mountain check), so the replacement applies to every ETB including Undying returns. Single-arg dispatcher path omits the replacement (Messenger enters untapped on shape-only paths, mirroring Creeping Tar Pit / Valakut). ETB triggered ability (CR 603.6a + CR 119.3) wired via `Triggers.OnEnterBattlefieldSelf` with a 1..1 "target opponent" `TargetRequest`; on resolution the chosen player loses 2 life via `Player.LoseLife`. Mirrors `HidetsugusSecondRiteFactory.BuildSpellDefinition`'s target-opponent shape and Earthshaker Khenra's chosen-target gating (CR 608.2b — no/illegal target = clean no-op). Agent-driven "target opponent" prompt deferred — v1 honours pre-supplied `ChosenTargets`. Use the `(owner, eventBus, triggers, replacements)` overload for fully-wired behavior) on top of Drannith Magistrate (Creature — Human Wizard {1}{W} 1/3 from Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths — `DrannithMagistrateFactory.Create` ships the 1/3 Human Wizard shape plus the printed static "Your opponents can't cast spells from anywhere other than their hands" (CR 113.6 / CR 601.2a). Wired via a new `CastFromHandOnlyRestrictionEffect` lifecycle binder (sibling of `SorcerySpeedRestrictionEffect` — same Attach/Detach + `CardMovedEvent` ETB/LTB sync shape + same opaque-token + lock-gated registry pattern). While Drannith is on the battlefield, every player returned by `opponentResolver` is registered into a new `_castFromHandOnly` slot on `CastingRestrictions`; `ActionValidator.ValidateCastSpell` consults `CastingRestrictions.MustCastFromHand(player)` and rejects any cast whose declared source zone (`CastSpellAction.FromZone`) is not `ZoneType.Hand` — including spells cast from exile (cascade, suspend, foretell, alt-cost from-exile flows), the graveyard (flashback / disturb / aftermath / escape / jump-start), the library, or the command zone. ## Headline numbers

| Metric | Count |
|---|---|
| Named factories | 1706 |
| Bespoke templates | 28 |
| Generic templates | 97 |
| JSON-defined cards | 591 |
| Distinct implemented card names (`[CardName]`) | 822 |
| Estimated Modern played-staple coverage | ~50% |

(Coverage estimate, 2026-05-26: a sampled diff of the live mtgtop8 Modern
metagame — 273 unique non-basic cards across 15 decklists / 14 archetypes —
found ~51% covered by named factories + land cycles + JSON cards. This is a
**lower bound**: it excludes regex spell-template coverage, so some "missing"
simple spells actually resolve. Gaps cluster in recent Universes Beyond
crossovers (Final Fantasy / Marvel / LOTR / Avatar) and 2025–26 set lands.
Distinct names > factory classes because cycle factories — fetch / shock /
surveil / pain / check / filter / horizon / bounce / manland — each register
many `[CardName]`s from one class.)

Both gate on the Flail being on the battlefield AND currently attached, so detach / blink / bounce automatically suspends doubling without explicit deregistration. Non-combat damage paths (spells, ping abilities) leave `DamageIntent.IsCombatDamage` false and the gates short-circuit (no doubling of Lightning Bolt's targeted damage to the equipped creature, no doubling of the equipped creature's `{T}` ping ability). `DamageDoubleReplacement` is the generic "double a combat-damage intent matching a per-side predicate" replacement primitive — future retrofits (Furnace of Rath, Gisela the Broken Blade, Boros Charm's third mode) can lean on the same shape with their own gates |

## Coverage by archetype

- **Burn** — Saturated. Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, Lava Dart, Skewer the Critics, Boros Charm, Eidolon of the Great Revel, Goblin Guide, Monastery Swiftspear (`MonasterySwiftspearFactory` — 1/2 Human Monk {R} with Haste + Prowess `KeywordAbility` markers + prowess `TriggeredAbility` via the shared `ProwessFactory.Build` helper), Rift Bolt, Searing Blaze, Lightning Helix, Sunscorched Desert (`SunscorchedDesertFactory` — Land from HOU; unconditional ETB-tapped replacement via `EntersTappedReplacement` on the supplied `ReplacementBus` + ETB triggered ability dealing 1 damage to any target via `SearingBlazeFactory.DealDamageWithPlaneswalker` + `{T}: Add {C}`), Roiling Vortex (`RoilingVortexFactory` — {R} Enchantment with the upkeep 1-to-each-player + free-cast 3-to-the-caster + {1}{R}/sac 3-to-any-target activated + "players can't gain life" replacement; closes the Modern Burn sideboard hate slot against UWx control and lifegain decks) all in. ~100%.
- **Death's Shadow** — Mid-high. Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, Snapcaster Mage, Stubborn Denial, Death's Shadow itself (CDA P/T scaled by controller life — Layer 7a) all in. Mishra's Bauble in. Temur Battle Rage absent. ~60%.
- **Murktide / Izzet Tempo** — High. Murktide Regent done, Counterspell done, Snapcaster Mage done, Lightning Bolt done, Expressive Iteration done, Ledger Shredder done, Consider done, Spell Pierce done, Subtlety done. Monastery Swiftspear done (`MonasterySwiftspearFactory` — Modern Izzet Prowess one-drop, Haste + Prowess wiring via the shared `ProwessFactory.Build` helper). Sprite Dragon done (`SpriteDragonFactory` — Modern Izzet Prowess two-drop, Flying + cast-noncreature +1/+1 counter accumulator; same predicate shape as `ProwessFactory` but persistent counters instead of one-turn pump). Soul-Scar Mage done (Prowess 1-drop that converts noncombat damage from controller-owned sources to -1/-1 counters on opponent creatures — first `IReplacementEffect<DamageIntent>` in the engine; pairs with Swiftspear and Sprite Dragon as the Izzet Prowess cheap-creature trio). Cori-Steel Cutter done (`CoriSteelCutterFactory` — {1}{R} Equipment from Tarkir: Dragonstorm; static "+1/+1 + trample + haste" via paired `AttachedBoostEffect` registrations at Layers 7c / 6, Flurry — second-spell-each-turn trigger spawning a 1/1 white Monk token with prowess + auto-attaching; Equip {1}{R}). Demilich done (`DemilichFactory` — {3}{U}{U}{U} 4/3 Zombie Wizard with Flying; `CostReductionAbility(totalReducer)` counts instant+sorcery cards in caster's graveyard for {U}-less-per-card discount floored at the three blue pips per CR 117.7c; on-cast `SpellCastEvent` self-trigger exiles two instants/sorceries from caster's graveyard with agent-prompt-via-`ChooseFromPileAsync` or deterministic first-two fallback). ~95%.

  **Izzet Tempo audit (this PR) — deferred riders enumerated, not fixed:**
  - `LedgerShredderFactory` — `SurveilEvent` shipped (Events/SurveilEvent.cs + Fx.Surveil bus publish + Triggers.OnSurveil) and the surveil-self counter trigger now subscribes to it directly. First-spell-each-turn counter still increments on every controller `SpellCastEvent`, including Ledger Shredder's own cast (intentional, but callers exercising the trigger manually must publish a `SpellCastEvent` for the first spell too).
  - `MurktideRegentFactory` — +1/+1 counters land via the ETB effect rather than a CR 122.1g "as it enters" replacement (no general 122.1g infrastructure). Delve count is stamped on `Card.PendingDelveExiledCount` rather than threaded through a generalised X-counter ETB framework. ETB-exile counts alongside delve exiles in the counter total (matches the v1 spec but not strict CR 122.1g ordering).
  - `ConsiderFactory` — surveil decision quality lives in registered `IPlayerAgent` impl; deterministic fallback sends peeked card to graveyard. No deferred rider on the printed effect itself.
  - `ExpressiveIterationTemplate` — deterministic 3-way split (first→hand, second→bottom, third→exile) instead of player-choice; needs a "choose-among" decision shape on the agent. "You may play the exiled card this turn" rider absent — requires the cast-from-exile-this-turn permission tracker (CR 118.10) shared by Lurrus / Den of the Bugbear / similar.
  - `ArclightPhoenixFactory` — graveyard-resident trigger's `activeZones = {Graveyard}` relies on `TriggerManager` respecting graveyard triggers; bus-driven firing requires the `(owner, bus, triggers)` overload. Cast count is captured at begin-combat-step time — spells cast after the trigger resolves don't retroactively requalify the Phoenix the same turn. "You may" prompt routes through `IPlayerAgent.ChooseYesNoAsync` (`BotIntent.Reanimate | BotIntent.CardAdvantage`) when an agent is supplied, auto-accept otherwise.
  - `DemilichFactory` (new) — flashback-style cast-from-graveyard-by-exiling-four clause from the real Innistrad print is deliberately NOT shipped (this v1 follows MODERN_COVERAGE row #10's engine-friendly spec). Attack-trigger copy-from-graveyard clause from the real print is also not in scope. On-cast exile is non-optional (no "may"). Agent prompt for the two graveyard cards uses `BotIntent.None`.
- **Mono-Green Tron** — High. Ancient Stirrings, Sylvan Scrying, Wurmcoil Engine done. Karn Liberated done. Karn, the Great Creator done. Tron lands (Urza's Mine + Tower + Power Plant) done with the conditional {2} mana ability — note the Power Plant `[CardName]` was registered under the hyphenated subtype spelling ("Urza's Power-Plant") until 2026-05-26 and never matched the real seed card, so Tron silently could not assemble; fixed to the space-form printed name. Green Sun's Zenith done — `GreenSunsZenithFactory` ({X}{G} Sorcery — tutor green creature mv ≤ X → battlefield with ZoneService-routed ETB triggers + printed self-shuffle into owner's library per CR 608.2c override, mirroring `EldritchEvolutionFactory`'s self-exile sequencing); the deck's premier toolbox tutor, fetches Wall of Roots / Dryad Arbor / Yawgmoth itself / Strangleroot Geist on curve. ## Top 20 Modern staples NOT yet implemented

Sorted roughly by build priority (small infra lift × high meta share). **Refreshed 2026-05-26** against a live mtgtop8 Modern metagame diff (273 unique cards / 14 archetypes). The prior "round 5" priority list shipped wholesale — its last survivor, **Simian Spirit Guide**, has since shipped (`SimianSpiritGuideFactory`, #1075). Cursecatcher, Silvergill Adept, Mantis Rider, Reflector Mage, Containment Priest, Meddling Mage, Skyclave Apparition, Leonin Arbiter, Temur Battle Rage, Boseiju, and the entire bounce-land cycle (Simic Growth Chamber et al.) all landed. The current gap is dominated by **recent Universes Beyond crossovers** (Final Fantasy / Marvel / LOTR / Avatar) and **2025–26 set lands** — the surveil-land cycle was completed in the PR that wrote this refresh (Commercial District, Hedge Maze, Lush Portico, Meticulous Archive, Raucous Theater, Shadowy Backstreet, Undercity Sewers), and the long-standing **Urza's Power Plant** dispatch bug (registered under the hyphenated subtype name, never matched the seed) was fixed so Tron can assemble.

Vintage / Legacy-only cards (Power Nine, original dual lands, Mind's Desire, Yawgmoth's Bargain, Library of Alexandria, Channel, Mox Pearl / Sapphire / Jet / Ruby / Emerald, Sneak Attack, Show and Tell, etc.) are deliberately excluded — this list tracks Modern-format staples only. (Dark Ritual, Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Lotus Petal, and Mana Crypt landed as named factories for Commander/historical-format coverage even though they're not Modern-legal.)

## How to update this doc

After merging a card-shipping PR:
1. Append the new card to the **Named factories** table (or **Template-covered (notable)** if it's a template port).
2. Remove it from **Top 20 not yet implemented** if it appears there.
3. Run `./scripts/update-coverage-headline.sh` to refresh the **Headline numbers** table from disk.
4. Bump the **Last updated** date at the top.

After merging a mechanic-infra PR:
1. Flip the relevant row in **Costs**, **Effects**, **Keywords**, or **Targeting / cast flow** to **Done (#PR)**.
2. If a top-20 entry's blocker is resolved, drop its difficulty one tier in the priority table.

### Multi-`[CardName]` for functional reprints

When two cards share an **identical resolve body** (e.g. Wrath of God +
Damnation — same sweep, different printed cost/colour), don't write two
factories. Stack multiple `[CardName]` attributes on the canonical factory
and expose a `public static <Card> Create(Player owner, string cardName)`
overload that branches on the requested name to produce the right printed
name + cost. The source generator
(`Majik.Core.SourceGen.NamedCardFactoryGenerator`) detects the second-arg
overload and dispatches each `[CardName]` through `Create(owner, name)`;
the plain `Create(owner)` overload stays as a convenience for callers
that don't care about the reprint variant. Headline factory-count drops
by one per collapsed wrapper — that's expected and the script handles it.

Don't apply this to **parametric cycles** (fetchlands, pact cycle, Mox
cycle) — those have per-card numeric or per-card-flavour differences and
stay as their own factories.

CI/pre-commit can call `./scripts/update-coverage-headline.sh --check` to fail when the headline counts drift from on-disk reality.

Keep this file terse. New cards = one row. New mechanics = one row. Long-form rationale lives in PR descriptions, not here.
